cards.title: sum-ID quarantine for early-unbuild liveness

lifecycle.advance_condition: only after EXP-SM-01 pilot acceptance and an isolated-worktree dispatch

cards.search_radius: A 129-qubit sum lifetime in square.rs plus the live B allocator free-pool interface in trailmix_ludicrous/mod.rs. No arithmetic identity, Pair-1/Pair-2 walk, replay scaling, codec tape, or square-addsub layout is changed. The representation crosses square->allocator->strip-key identity, so the structural researcher scopes it and hands mutation to the cross-cell reframer/implementer pair.
cards.mechanism: After c_prod reverse, perform the exact sum inverse early, but place the 129 now-zero sum IDs into a quarantined-zero pool rather than B::free_qubits. At the original late-unbuild location, release that pool in exactly the same LIFO order that free_zeroes(sum) would have used. During a/b applies active_qubits is lower by 129, so existing square vents may be selected; meanwhile ordinary allocation cannot consume sum IDs, preserving the baseline allocation mapping for unaffected a/b operations. This is a new default-off TLM_SQUARE_SUM_ID_QUARANTINE mechanism, not a pre-existing knob and not a reapplication of the SQ-01 patch.

cards.reversible_invariant_and_proof_obligatio: Algebraic invariant: lambda and output_reg remain bit-identical to late-unbuild SQ-01-off behavior; build_sum_hi_lo and unbuild_sum_hi_lo still form an exact inverse around c_prod only. Liveness invariant: quarantined IDs are known |0>, unavailable to alloc_qubit, absent from active_qubits, and released once in baseline free-stack order. Proof obligations: (1) an instrumented allocator trace proves a/b allocation IDs equal default IDs through the late release point; (2) no double-free/alias/reacquire; (3) phase word stays zero—no measurement is introduced by quarantine itself, and every added vent Hmr bit has its matching cz_if; (4) all allocated ancillas, including the quarantined set, are zero at release; (5) full four-check evaluation only after re-mine and lambda gates.
cards.target_Q_vent_check: Mandatory but expected to fail as a Q benefit: TRACE_PHASE_ACTIVE plus artifact max-id must remain Q=1154. Under the candidate, repeat a bounded TLM_TARGET_Q=1153 profile solely to confirm the known tape-free/square peak remains binding; stop any Q claim if max id remains 1153 or Toffoli rises. Quarantine must never allocate IDs above the default high-water mark.
cards.cheapest_discriminator: Before a candidate build, an isolated unit-level allocator trace/miter with synthetic `free c_prod -> early sum quarantine -> representative a/b alloc -> late release` must show byte-for-byte equality of allocation IDs against late sum free behavior while active_qubits is exactly 129 lower in the middle. It is cheap, does not invoke the evaluator, and falsifies the key premise before touching a scored candidate. Next only after approval: on/off TRACE_PHASE_ACTIVE + TRACE_TLM_CCX in an isolated worktree, then compare stale-key categories; no full census launch.
cards.predeclared_falsifier: REFUTE this mechanism if the allocator miter cannot simultaneously preserve baseline a/b IDs and lower active_qubits by 129; OR if the flag-on build has Q>1154; OR if its pre-re-mine stale-key set is not materially lower than SQ-01's 6799 while raw vent saving is no better than -1086 CCX; OR if the stream-specific re-mine returns net executed-T >=0; OR any phase/ancilla/correctness/reversibility check fails.
